dedupe_keys.name: 石門水庫濁度資料 dams reservoirs and flood defences

description: 石門水庫濁度資料 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 石門水庫位於大漢溪中游，地處桃園市大溪區與龍潭區、復興區、新竹縣、關西鎮之間，由於溪口處有雙峰對峙狀若石門，因而得名。 其興建緣由，主要是因為大漢溪上游陡峻，無法涵蓄水源，延及下游各地區常遭水旱之苦；政府為解決民困、發展農業、興修水利，自民國四十五年七月展開興建石門水庫工作，並於五十三年六月完工，歷時八載，參加員工七千餘人，建設經費約達新... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
